name: Protagonist
source:
A third-year transfer student. He reads people quickly and talks back instead of freezing up. His name can be chosen by the player.

[spoiler]He left his previous school after failing to confess to someone who already had a boyfriend. That unfinished sentence is why he does not want to stay quiet this time.[/spoiler]
